record: level, tool, premises and status as in STXlib's verification programme, section 6; a discharged obligation records the source hash it was proved against

obligations.statement: dispatch runs only when sequence != 0; otherwise returns HostDispatchError::sequence_zero, unchanged.
Unless sequence != 0, dispatch changes nothing observable.
dispatch runs only when sequence > last_sequence; otherwise returns HostDispatchError::non_monotonic_sequence, unchanged.
Unless sequence > last_sequence, dispatch changes nothing observable.

dispatch runs only when (phase != phase_constructed or attach != 0 or shutdown != 0) and (phase != phase_attached or attach == 0) and (phase != phase_close_authorized or closed != 0 or shutdown != 0 or passive_terminal != 0) and (phase != phase_closed or shutdown != 0); otherwise returns HostDispatchError::invalid_lifecycle, unchanged.

Unless (phase != phase_constructed or attach != 0 or shutdown != 0) and (phase != phase_attached or attach == 0) and (phase != phase_close_authorized or closed != 0 or shutdown != 0 or passive_terminal != 0) and (phase != phase_closed or shutdown != 0), dispatch changes nothing observable.
dispatch runs only when finite(width) and finite(height) and width > 0 and height > 0; otherwise returns HostDispatchError::invalid_geometry, unchanged.
Unless finite(width) and finite(height) and width > 0 and height > 0, dispatch changes nothing observable.
dispatch runs only when finite(scale) and scale > 0; otherwise returns HostDispatchError::invalid_geometry, unchanged.
Unless finite(scale) and scale > 0, dispatch changes nothing observable.

When several of dispatch's refusals apply, the first of dispatch_sequence, then dispatch_order, then the state refusal, then dispatch_lifecycle, then dispatch_size, then dispatch_scale is the one reported.
dispatch in shutdown: returns HostDispatchError::after_shutdown, changing nothing observable.
shutdown succeeding in any state leaves the object in shutdown.

An accepted attach moves constructed to attached; a closing event that is not cancelled, hidden, a session end or a query moves attached to close_authorized; an accepted closed event moves to closed; shutdown, or a dispatch after the window was destroyed, moves to shutdown. Window::host_lifecycle_phase reports the same phase while the window lives (HostSession::set_phase writes both).
obligations.method: inspection of HostSession::DispatchVisitor and set_phase; the hosts' lifecycle tests
